content.title: Shuttle Pharmaceuticals says reverse stock split to become effective June 16
content.summary: Shuttle Pharmaceuticals (SHPH) announced that the reverse stock split will become effective on June 16, at 12:01 a.m., Eastern Time. The company’s common stock will continue to trade on The Nasdaq Capital Market under the existing symbol “SHPH” and will begin trading on a split-adjusted basis when the market opens on June 16.
